# toskar

```go
import "github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/go"
```

Package toskar is the official Go SDK for Toskar: local AI across your own computers.

```
c, err := toskar.New()
for e, err := range c.ChatStream(ctx, api.ChatJSONRequestBody{Message: "Hi"}) {
	if err != nil { return err }
	if e.Type == "token" { fmt.Print(e.Content) }
}
```

Package api is every route, typed, generated from Toskar Core's API spec; Client embeds its client, and Data unwraps an answer.

<a name="ContractVersion"></a>ContractVersion is the client contract this SDK was built for.

```go
const ContractVersion = "1.56"
```

<a name="DefaultURL"></a>DefaultURL is this computer's Toskar Core, which needs no key.

```go
const DefaultURL = "http://127.0.0.1:7331"
```

<a name="ToskarRelay"></a>ToskarRelay is Toskar's own relay. It's asked only with a route token.

```go
const ToskarRelay = "relay.toskar.ai"
```

## Variables

<a name="ErrPinMismatch"></a>Errors from pairing and connecting.

```go
var (
    // ErrPinMismatch is a computer whose certificate isn't the pinned one:
    // stop, and pair again to trust a new certificate.
    ErrPinMismatch = errors.New("toskar: the computer's certificate isn't the one paired with")
    // ErrNotConfirmed is pairing the person stopped at the short pin.
    ErrNotConfirmed = errors.New("toskar: the short pin wasn't confirmed")
    // ErrUnreachable is no way in answering, at home or away.
    ErrUnreachable = errors.New("toskar: the computer can't be reached")
    // ErrNoRecord is no address record to find the computer away from home:
    // it may be off or asleep, or have no access from anywhere.
    ErrNoRecord = errors.New("toskar: no address record for the computer")

    ErrRecordSealed = errors.New("toskar: the record doesn't open with this route secret")
    ErrRecordPin    = errors.New("toskar: the record isn't from the pinned computer")
    ErrRecordStale  = errors.New("toskar: the record is too old")
)
```

```go
func Check(r interface{ StatusCode() int }, err error) error
```

Check returns nil for a successful generated call, or its error. It suits calls that answer nothing, such as deletes.

```go
func Data[T any, R interface {
    StatusCode() int
    GetJSON200() *T
}](r R, err error) (T, error)
```

```
models, err := toskar.Data(c.ListModelsWithResponse(ctx))
```

<a name="APIError"></a>
## type [APIError](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/errors.go#L15-L20>)

APIError is an error from Toskar Core: \{"error": \{"code", "message", "details"\}\}. Code is stable, such as ErrorCodeNoModelInstalled; Message is English text for logs; Details has the values the message needs.

```
var e *toskar.APIError
if errors.As(err, &e) && e.Code == toskar.ErrorCodeNoModelInstalled { … }
```

```go
type APIError struct {
    Status  int
    Code    string
    Message string
    Details map[string]any
}
```

### func \(\*APIError\) [Error](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/errors.go#L22>)

```go
func (e *APIError) Error() string
```



<a name="ChatStreamEvent"></a>
## type [ChatStreamEvent](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/client.go#L192-L196>)

ChatStreamEvent is one event of a streamed chat: a token with the next piece of the answer \(Type "token", Content\), or done once it's finished and saved \(Type "done", Metrics when the runtime reported them\).

```go
type ChatStreamEvent struct {
    Type    string
    Content string
    Metrics *api.GenerationMetrics
}
```

<a name="Client"></a>
## type [Client](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/client.go#L30-L37>)

Client is a connection to Toskar Core.

Its embedded api.ClientWithResponses reaches every route, typed from Core's API spec, and Data unwraps an answer:

```
models, err := toskar.Data(c.ListModelsWithResponse(ctx))
```

and its own methods cover what's easier by hand: Chat, ChatStream, and Events.

```go
type Client struct {
    *api.ClientWithResponses
    BaseURL string
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/client.go#L78>)

```go
func New(opts ...Option) (*Client, error)
```

New connects to Toskar Core.

<a name="Client.Chat"></a>
### func \(\*Client\) [Chat](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/client.go#L175>)

```go
func (c *Client) Chat(ctx context.Context, req api.ChatJSONRequestBody) (*api.ChatAnswer, error)
```

Chat asks once and waits for the whole answer. Stream is set for you.

<a name="Client.ChatStream"></a>
### func \(\*Client\) [ChatStream](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/client.go#L206>)

```go
func (c *Client) ChatStream(ctx context.Context, req api.ChatJSONRequestBody) iter.Seq2[ChatStreamEvent, error]
```

ChatStream asks and yields the answer as it's written: tokens, then done. A failure is yielded as an \*APIError with its code, such as ErrorCodeNoModelInstalled, and ends the stream.

```
for e, err := range c.ChatStream(ctx, toskar.ChatJSONRequestBody{Message: "Hi"}) {
	if err != nil { return err }
	if e.Type == "token" { fmt.Print(e.Content) }
}
```

<a name="Client.Events"></a>
### func \(\*Client\) [Events](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/client.go#L256>)

```go
func (c *Client) Events(ctx context.Context) iter.Seq2[api.Event, error]
```

Events yields what happens on Toskar as it happens, such as models loading and automations running, until ctx is done or you stop.

```go
func (c *Client) Path() Path
```

Path is how the client reaches its paired computer now, or "" before its first request, or for a client that isn't a paired device.

<a name="Device"></a>
## type [Device](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/connect.go#L39-L47>)

Device is what a paired device keeps, to connect again. Save it as a password is saved: APIKey and the route's Secret and Token are secrets.

```go
type Device struct {
    // Address is the computer's host:port at home.
    Address string `json:"address"`
    APIKey  string `json:"api_key"`
    // Pin is "sha256:<hex>" of the computer's certificate. It only ever
    // comes from pairing.
    Pin   string `json:"pin"`
    Route *Route `json:"route,omitempty"`
}
```

<a name="Pair"></a>

```go
func Pair(ctx context.Context, address, code, deviceName string, confirm ConfirmPin) (*Device, error)
```

Pair pairs with the computer at address \(host:port, as found or typed\) using the code Connect a device shows on it. The device must be on the computer's local network.

WithDevice connects as a paired device: every connection pinned to its computer's certificate, at home when it answers, and otherwise directly or through its relay, from its address record.

```go
func WithKey(key string) Option
```

WithKey is the API key for any address other than this computer's loopback. Default: TOSKAR\_API\_KEY.

<a name="WithRetries"></a>
### func [WithRetries](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/client.go#L62>)

```go
func WithRetries(n int) Option
```

WithRetries is how many times a safe request \(GET, HEAD, OPTIONS\) that fails to connect or answers 502, 503, or 504 is retried. Default 2.

<a name="WithTimeout"></a>
### func [WithTimeout](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/client.go#L67>)

```go
func WithTimeout(d time.Duration) Option
```

WithTimeout is how long to wait for an answer to start; a streamed answer then runs for as long as it takes. Default 60 seconds; 0 waits as long as it takes. It applies to the default HTTP client only.

```go
func WithURL(url string) Option
```

WithURL is where Toskar Core answers. Default: TOSKAR\_URL, or DefaultURL, this computer.

```go
func OpenRecord(blob []byte, secret, pin string, now time.Time, maxAge time.Duration) (*Record, error)
```

<a name="Route"></a>
## type [Route](<https://github.com/yeixio/toskar-sdks/blob/main/go/connect.go#L51-L59>)

Route is how to find the computer away from home, when it has access from anywhere.

```go
type Route struct {
    // Secret is the route secret, base64url without padding.
    Secret string `json:"secret"`
    ID     string `json:"id"`
    // Relay is the relay the computer uses, such as relay.toskar.ai.
    Relay string `json:"relay"`
    // Token lets the device look the computer up on Toskar's relay.
    Token string `json:"token,omitempty"`
}
```
